description: Orwacholi (Leb Acoli) ni rurimi rwa Luo orugambwa abantu nka akakaikuru kamwe n'ekicweka omu matemba ga Uganda, ahari Gulu, Kitgum na Pader, n'enyima y'ensharo omu South Sudan.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Acholi courses (#130) with low confidence in Acholi; needs a native-speaker review. The Runyankore needs a native-speaker review too; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/ach).

why.title: Orurimi rwa **Gulu, Kitgum n'amatemba.**
why.text: Orwacholi nirugambwa omu matemba ga Uganda kandi nirushushana n'Orulango, Orwalur n'Orujaluo rwa Kenya, n'ahabw'ekyo kurwega nikukwigurira endimi nyingi za Luo. Ruyege ahabw'eka, orugyendo, emirimo, n'ebyeshongoro, emizano n'engano z'amatemba.

cards.title: Ahabw'eka
cards.text: Gamba na banyakuru n'ab'eka omuri Gulu na Kitgum.

cards.title: Ahabw'abatambuzi
cards.text: Tambura kuruga Gulu kuhika Kitgum, Pader na Kiira aha Karuma.

cards.title: Ahabw'abarikwenda kumanya
cards.text: Shanga orurimi rwa Luo oruriho amaraka agarikuzamuka n'okushuuma, enyukuta empanvu n'empimpi, kandi orutaine bika by'amaziina.

landing.audience: Abarikutandika, eka ezirikuruga Acholi, n'abatambuzi abarikuza omu matemba ga Uganda.
landing.first: Okuramukya, okweyanjura n'enamba, bwanyima eka, ebyokurya, akatale, eshaaha, ebifo, omuka n'amagara, ekicweka ku kicweka.

cast.emma: Omugyenyi orikwega Orwacholi atakagiire omu rugyendo
